targets.expr: (clamp_max(sum by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_training_count_ytd{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) * clamp_max(clamp_min((avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) - 300) / 3300, 0), 1) / 6 * 50, 50)) + (clamp_max(clamp_min((1 - (time() - max by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_last_run_timestamp_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$"))) / (90 * 86400)) * 30, 0), 30)) + (clamp_max((avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) / scalar(avg(avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) and on(model) topk(5, sum by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_training_count_ytd{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")))))) * 20, 20))

sort_desc((clamp_max(sum by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_training_count_ytd{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) * clamp_max(clamp_min((avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) - 300) / 3300, 0), 1) / 6 * 50, 50)) + (clamp_max(clamp_min((1 - (time() - max by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_last_run_timestamp_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$"))) / (90 * 86400)) * 30, 0), 30)) + (clamp_max((avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) / scalar(avg(avg by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_avg_duration_seconds{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")) and on(model) topk(5, sum by (model) (label_replace(clearml_task_training_count_ytd{project!~"ClearML.*",project!~"media/.*"}, "model","$1","project",".*/([^/]+)$")))))) * 20, 20)))
